senses.gloss: A pupil in the elephant's eye.

इषि(षी)का
[इष् गत्यादौ क्बुन् अत इत्वम्] 
__1 Reed, rush, stalk of grass; कुशकाशशरेषिकाः [[Rām.]]; [[Kaṭh. 2. 6. 17.]] °अस्त्रम् [[R. 12. 23.]] 
__2 An arrow. 
__3 A sort of sugar-cane; Saccharum Spontaneum. 
__4 A small stick of wood or iron used to see whether gold in a crucible is melted or not. 
__5 A brush. 
__6 The eye-ball of an elephant. 
__7 A thorny plant; संनिकर्षादिषीकाभिर्मोचितः परमाद्भयात् [[Rām. 2. 8. 30.]] 
-Comp. 
-तूलम् also इषीकतूलम् the point or upper part of a reed; इष्टकेषीकामालानां चिततूलभारिषु [[P. VI. 3. 35]]; यथेषीकातूलग्नौ प्रोतम् [[Ch. Up. 5. 24. 3.]]

__1 An elephant's eye-ball. Edgerton, the author of [[Mātaṅga L.]], however, says that this meaning is wrong and points out that it means, 'The under surface of the top of the eye-socket of an elephant. ईषिका त्बक्षिकूटकम् [[Mātaṅga L. 6. 9.]] 
__2 A painter's brush. 
__3 A weapon, arrow, dart. 
__4 A kind of missile.

__1 A painter's brush. 
__2 An ingot-mould. 
__3 = इषीका q. v.

p. p. (fr. इष् 4 cl.) 
__1 Moved, driven, sent, despatched. 
__2 Excited, animated. 
__3 Quick, speedy.

ईशिता,
 
-त्वम् Superiority, greatness, one of the eight Siddhis or attributes of Śiva. See अणिमन्.

a. Ved. [इष्-गतौ-किरच्] 
__1 Juicy, succulent, refreshing, fresh. 
__2 Powerful, strong, quick, active. 3 Moving. 
-रः Fire. 
-रम् ind. Quickly. स्वधामिषिरां पर्यपश्यन् [[Rv. 10. 157. 5.]]
a. [ईश्-तृच्] An owner, a master, proprietor. m. The lord of the Universe; न चेशिता नैव च तस्य लिङ्गम् [[Śvet. Up. 6. 9.]] अव्यक्तोऽभूदीशितेव प्रणादः [[Śi. 18. 3.]]
a. To be reigned or ruled over; ईशितव्यैः किमस्माभिरीशस्यैतद्विडम्बनम् [[Bhāg. 10. 23. 45.]]

a. [ईश्-णिनि] Commanding, reigning &c. m. 
__1 A god. 
__2 A husband. 
__3 A lord, master. 
-नी Supremacy; ईशत ईशिनीभिः [[Śvet. Up. 3. 1.]]
